summary: Frontend-only regression on admin console after cross-platform notify/banner fix. Ran a single Playwright script (mobile viewport 390x844) covering: admin login, batch create/empty-title-validation/delete, notes PDF upload/list/delete, video upload (~2MB)/list/delete, and quiz create via qa-create-quiz deep-link with tab=quiz. ALL 13 assertions PASSED. window.alert validation fires correctly; window.confirm auto-accepted via page.on('dialog'); banners appear with expected copy ('created', 'Batch deleted', 'uploaded to library', 'File deleted', 'Quiz "..." created'); Library list shows the newly uploaded PDF and Video rows before deletion; deep-link to /(admin)/content?tab=quiz opens Create Quiz tab pre-selected (quiz-title visible without clicking tab-quiz). No red screens, no runtime errors, no failed network calls observed. Only console noise: RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) and expo-notifications push-listener-on-web warning — non-blocking.

issues: RN-Web deprecation warnings in console: 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents' — cosmetic, from RN 0.76+ web renderer, safe to defer but should be migrated to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents when convenient.

action_items: No functional action items — admin console batch/notes/video/quiz flows all verified working via UI.
Optional cleanup: migrate `shadow*` style props to `boxShadow` and `pointerEvents` prop to `style.pointerEvents` to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.

Optional: login.tsx still uses raw `Alert.alert` for validation/failure (lines 36, 52). It works on web only because RN-Web polyfills to window.alert in some cases, but for consistency consider switching to the shared `notify()` helper used elsewhere.
critical_code_review_comments: notify.ts correctly branches on Platform.OS === 'web' to use window.alert/window.confirm — good cross-platform pattern.
content.tsx upload handler correctly builds FormData for web (Blob) vs native (uri object) — verified live via 2MB video upload succeeding with progress events.

batches.tsx and content.tsx both wrap banner state with 4s auto-clear timeout without cleanup on unmount; low risk but could leak setState-after-unmount warnings on fast navigation. Consider clearTimeout in a useEffect return.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test data (QA Batch, QA PDF, QA Video, QA Quiz) — all except QA Quiz were deleted at end of run. QA Quiz remains (no DELETE endpoint for quizzes, as noted in request).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://smart-class-recorder-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin creds admin/admin123 are prefilled on the admin tab. All admin flows have stable testIDs. To auto-handle web dialogs, register page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()) BEFORE any action that could trigger window.alert/confirm. For file uploads use page.expect_file_chooser() + fc.set_files({'name','mimeType','buffer'}) — DocumentPicker on web opens a normal file input. Banners auto-hide after 4s; wait_for_function on innerText immediately after the action.
rca_of_issue: Original bug (Alert.alert silent on web) already fixed by main agent via notify()/confirm() helpers + on-screen banners + Library/Existing-batches lists. This retest confirms the fix end-to-end and closes out the user-reported 'admin console not functional' bug.
